# Turn a YouTube AdSense payments export into a Xero or QuickBooks journal

> Free YouTube AdSense to Xero and QuickBooks journal converter: books AdSense payments to revenue, US tax withheld to a separate receivable, the bank deposit and the realised FX gain or loss, splits by month, and downloads a balanced journal for Xero, QuickBooks Online or QuickBooks Desktop.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
